description_short: Shows the fuel and maintenance your trucks spend hauling each resource, split by carrying and collecting, and filterable by vehicle class.
description_long:
The vanilla vehicle monitor shows quantity moved and route count per resource. A resource hauled in bulk over a short distance can look just as important as one hauled in small amounts over a long haul, even though the second is quietly eating far more fuel and maintenance.

This adds a window (default shortcut F8) that shows the cost directly, in the units you actually pay it in. One compact card per resource, sorted by fuel burned, each showing two rows: the cost of carrying that resource on top, and beneath it the cost of the empty run out to collect it - which burns at the same full rate and is about half the real cost of a round trip.

Two independent columns of tickboxes filter the view: by job (general operations, mining, refuelling) and by vehicle class (pickup trucks, trucks, haul trucks, amphibious trucks). A dropdown scopes everything to the last 1, 3, 6 or 12 months. The totals row and the Unattributed figure always reflect whatever is ticked.

Fuel and maintenance are read from the game's own model rather than estimated, and nothing accrues while the game is paused or a truck is parked. Stats persist across save and load, stored per save.

Trucks only - excavators, tree harvesters, planters and rocket transporters are not counted.
